updates.title: Updates
updates.explainPolicy: Only missing or recognized official outdated USB policies are eligible. Custom rules are preserved. USB changes use one system authorization dialog; this app never collects a password. AppImage replacement stays user-local. Setup is separate and user-led; the app never installs the helper.
updates.explainApply: Apply updates retries unfinished eligible operations only. A written policy is not written again; a reload error still needs inspection. Relaunch app requests a restart, not a second installation.

app.restartDeferred: AppImage replaced; restart may be deferred. Use Relaunch app explicitly.
app.restartRequested: AppImage replaced; restart requested, not confirmed.

policy.reloadFailed: USB policy written; reload or activation failed.
policy.reloaded: USB policy written and reload completed; reconnect the mouse if needed.

policyState.outdated: An official USB permissions update is available.
policyState.custom: Custom USB permissions preserved; no automatic overwrite.
policyState.unavailable: USB permissions update unavailable for this release.
policyState.error: USB permissions could not be inspected.

errors.device_disconnected: Mouse disconnected. Reconnect the receiver or mouse, then try again.
errors.stale_binding: Device connection changed. Refresh the device list and select the mouse again before saving.

power.title: Key response time

reset.title: Reset to factory
reset.warning: Restore mouse defaults and clear local profiles after acknowledgement. Onboard macros may remain.
reset.detailsBody: This resets DPI (active stage 2), lighting (Static DPI), sleep (0.5 minutes), key response time (4 ms), polling (1000 Hz), and default button remapping. Local profiles are cleared only after all four supported lanes acknowledge; onboard macro deletion and complete device memory erasure are unverified.
